verdict.rationale: BigQuery's Gemini/Conversational Analytics features let users query, join, and visualize data using natural language, and generate/explain SQL or Python code from NL prompts, which directly supports natural-language operation of the product. However, this is all first-party doc-based evidence with no independent/hands-on corroboration, and NL support seems scoped to querying/exploration rather than full operational control (e.g., admin, pipeline management). Missing for 10: independent verification of NL feature reliability, evidence of NL commands controlling broader BigQuery operations beyond analytics/query generation.
